title: Zaporizhzhia region provides UAH 105M worth of military equipment to Ukrainian forces in October
summary: The Zaporizhzhia region provided the Ukrainian Defense Forces with military equipment worth more than UAH 105 million in October, with 45 units receiving assistance.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,500 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 2, 2026, have reached approximately 1,592,770 personnel, including 2,500 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Air defenses down 154 out of 193 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine since evening
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 154 out of the 193 drones used by Russian troops to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 1.

title: Ukrainian, Canadian foreign ministers discuss G20 meeting outcomes, steps toward de-escalation of war
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha described as productive a phone call he held with his Canadian counterpart, Anita Anand, on November 1.

title: Ukrainian Navy destroys six Russian aircraft, ten multiple launch rocket systems in October
summary: The Ukrainian Navy destroyed six Russian aircraft and ten multiple launch rocket systems (MLRS) in October.

title: Ukraine's territorial integrity is in Türkiye's long-term interests – expert
summary: Ukraine's stability and territorial integrity are in Türkiye's long-term interests, as they directly affect its policy in the Black Sea region and the Turkic world.

title: Lubinets announces end of ceasefire in Oleshky
summary: The ceasefire that had been in effect from October 27 to November 1 in the area around the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky, Kherson region, to allow a humanitarian operation, has ended.

title: Russian athletes have no place in Finland if Moscow continues war, Foreign Minister says
summary: Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen has said that Russian athletes will have no place in Finland next year if their country continues its war against Ukraine.

title: Hackers breach Russia's statistics agency, obtain data on Russian losses in Ukraine
summary: Belarusian hacktivist group Cyber Partisans, together with the hacker group Silent Crow, have claimed responsibility for breaching the internal IT infrastructure of Russia's Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat).

title: Ukrainian Film Festival kicks off in Poland on Nov 2, with 50 films to be screened in 12 cities
summary: The 11th Ukrainian Film Festival will take place in Poland, featuring 50 films. Screenings are scheduled in 12 cities, with two new venues joining the festival this year – Bielsko-Biala and Zielona Gora.

title: Russian SRG activity along Ukraine’s northern border drops significantly – military spox
summary: The activity of Russian sabotage and reconnaissance groups (SRG) along Ukraine’s northern border has decreased significantly.

title: Ukrainian judoka Savytskyi wins bronze at Grand Slam in UAE
summary: The latest 2026 Grand Slam tournament was held in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, with 11 Ukrainian judokas competing.

title: Temporary ceasefire enables evacuation of 173 people from 10 communities in Kherson region
summary: A total of 173 residents were evacuated from 10 dangerous communities on the right bank of the Kherson region during a temporary ceasefire. Among those rescued were 24 people with limited mobility and 21 children. No minors remain in the village of Stanislav or the city of Beryslav.

title: Game of Thrones star Nikolaj Coster-Waldau calls for increased support for Ukraine’s energy sector
summary: During his visit to Ukraine, Danish actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, a Goodwill Ambassador for the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), called on international partners to continue providing financial support to Ukrainian communities and to help restore energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

title: Ukraine’s MFA rejects Mali, Niger accusations that Ukraine supports illegal armed groups
summary: Ukraine firmly rejects accusations by Mali and Niger that it allegedly supports illegal armed groups and interferes in the internal affairs of Sahel states.

title: Lubinets: Ukraine will not disclose number of citizens evacuated from Oleshky
summary: Ukraine will not release official figures on the number of citizens who have returned from Oleshky to territory controlled by Ukraine, or on those who have left for territory controlled by Russia, in accordance with agreements reached with the Russian side.

title: Lubinets says further steps being prepared for humanitarian missions involving Russia: Ombudsmen appeal to Melania Trump
summary: Ukrainian Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights Dmytro Lubinets has appealed to Melania Trump to extend the positive experience of Oleshky to other settlements.

title: Lubinets: Ukraine leaves large amount of humanitarian aid in Oleshky for residents who remain in city
summary: Ukraine has provided substantial humanitarian aid to the people who remained in Oleshky—food, water, medicine, fuel for generators, and specialized equipment for the hospital, which continues to operate in the city.

title: Minefields kill 279 Russian troops on southern front in October – military
summary: In October, Russian forces lost 279 servicemen and 60 pieces of weapons and military equipment after triggering mine and explosive barriers in the Huliaipole, Orikhiv and Oleksandrivka sectors of the front.

title: Russian drone attack on residential area in Sumy district kills one and injures another
summary: Russian forces launched a drone attack on a residential area in the Mykolaiv community of the Sumy district; one person was killed and another was seriously injured.

title: Bodies of military personnel, civilians taken out of Oleshky during humanitarian mission – Lubinets
summary: The bodies of deceased Ukrainian citizens, both military personnel and civilians, were taken out of Oleshky and nearby areas during the humanitarian mission.

title: Flash: Russia increases deployment of satellite-based EW systems targeting Starlink
summary: Russian occupation forces are increasing the number of satellite electronic warfare (EW) systems that interfere with Starlink operations.

title: One fatality, five injured in overnight fire at boarding facility near Kyiv
summary: One person was found dead and five others injured in a fire at a boarding facility in the village of Sofiivska Borshchahivka, Bucha district, Kyiv region.

title: Russian FPV drones attack special-purpose vehicles near Kharkiv, killing one
summary: A man was killed in a Russian FPV drone strike in the territory of the Malodanilivka territorial community in Kharkiv district.

title: New support program helps farmers with demining and production recovery
summary: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United Nations World Food Program (WFP), is launching a new program to support farmers.

title: Russian bombs strike apartment building in Sloviansk, klling one and injuring six
summary: Russian forces have carried out an airstrike using two FAB-250 bombs on the city center of Sloviansk, Donetsk region. One bomb struck a multi-story apartment building, killing a woman and injuring six people.

title: Ukraine’s Armed Forces report record 2,500 Russian troops killed in one day
summary: No sooner had October become the month with the highest enemy casualties since the start of Russia's invasion of Ukraine than, on November 1, the record for daily casualties was broken

title: Tender announced for 2027 food procurement for AFU
summary: The Defense Procurement Agency (DOT) of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine has announced a tender for the procurement of food products for 2027 for the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the State Special Transport Service, with an estimated value of UAH 43.8 billion.

title: Russia officially withdraws from European Anti-Torture Convention
summary: On November 1, Russia officially withdrew from the European Convention for the Prevention of Torture. As a result, the Prevention of Torture and Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (ECPT) will no longer be able to inspect places of detention in the country.

title: Russian drone strikes facility in Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region
summary: Russian troops attacked a business in the Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region using a drone.

title: Russian forces strike Chuhuiv district in Kharkiv region, several people injured
summary: The Russian military attacked the village of Prymorske in the Pechenihy territorial community of Chuhuiv district, injuring two people.

title: Russian attack damages cat shelter in Odesa
summary: A Russian attack on the night of November 2 damaged a building in Odesa that housed a cat shelter and was also home to two internally displaced women. One animal was killed, and four others are still missing.

title: Attack on Izium leaves one dead and 11 injured, damaging homes and stores
summary: The number of people injured as a result of Russian strikes on the city of Izium on November 2 has risen to 11, with one fatality.

title: Russian drone attacks civilian car in Kherson, leaving two injured
summary: Two people were injured in Kherson as a result of a Russian drone attack on a car.

title: Apartment building damaged in Russian drone attack on Vinnytsia
summary: An apartment building in Vinnytsia was damaged in a Russian drone attack on the morning of November 2.

title: Nearly 800 people evacuated from Oleshky during humanitarian mission – Melania Trump
summary: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump has called for the ceasefire in Oleshky to be used as a foundation for lasting peace between Ukraine and Russia.

title: Russian forces strike Izium, casualties reportred, city left without power
summary: Russian forces attacked Izium with guided aerial bombs on the morning of November 2.

title: Russian forces attack homes, energy, logistics infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, three injured
summary: Two adults and a child were injured in Russian attacks on energy, logistics and civilian infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region.

title: Russian forces strike regional power utility facility in Odesa region
summary: A power facility in the Odesa region came under an enemy attack overnight on November 2.

title: Four injured in overnight Russian attack on Odesa
summary: Four people were injured in a Russian attack on Odesa overnight on November 2.

title: Drones attack Samara oil pumping station in Russia – media
summary: Russia's Samara region came under a drone attack early on November 2. The likely target was the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station (LPDS) in the town of Prosvet, where a fire broke out following the attack.

title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Vasyshcheve in Kharkiv region rises to 12
summary: Twelve people, including a child, were injured in a Russian attack on the village of Vasyshcheve in the Kharkiv region on Sunday, November 1.
